evidence_ceiling: Static inspection of exact durable repository artifacts and current authority graphs only. No interactive browser execution is claimed by this recovery closure.

entries.rule: Do not rank PageKit/Class Player artifacts by version number.
entries.reason: V26 owns the registered stable rollback capability while V37 owns a narrower best-known laser transform capability.

entries.rule: Catalog live status does not imply Current, Human Accepted, Served or lineage ownership.
entries.reason: V26, V37 and Psicoanálisis are all live catalog entries with different authority roles.

entries.rule: Do not call the whole V37 UX Human Accepted.
entries.reason: Lineage explicitly records V37 as CANDIDATE with empty human_accepted_scope and a whole-UX acceptance loss.
All three inspected implementations gate erasing behind an active pointer press state.

entries.rule: Do not claim V26 or the Psico PageKit layer can undo an erased stroke.
entries.reason: Their visible undo paths pop the latest surviving stroke; erased strokes are removed directly without a typed reversible erase action.

entries.rule: Do not downgrade V37 typed undo when adopting its erase/object behaviors.
entries.reason: V37 records typed actions for add/erase/clear and object paste/delete/transform operations.

entries.rule: Generic Pointer Events do not establish Wacom pressure or pen-button support.
entries.reason: No inspected implementation reads pressure or pointer button state as a stylus capability.

entries.rule: Do not convert descriptive UI text mentioning Wacom into implementation evidence.
entries.reason: V37 labels a CanvasSurface as Pointer Events / Wacom while its inspected code does not consume pressure/buttons.

entries.rule: Responsive/full-viewport presentation is not the application Fullscreen API.
entries.reason: No requestFullscreen implementation was evidenced in the inspected Class Player artifacts.

entries.rule: Iframe allowFullscreen does not prove application-wide fullscreen support.
entries.reason: The Psico consumer enables fullscreen on a lazily created embed iframe only.

entries.rule: Do not collapse V37 board-session tabs and Psico whiteboard sheet tabs into one semantic model.
entries.reason: V37 boards carry per-board ink, objects and undo; Psico sheets are canvas surfaces distinguished mainly by sheet type and strokes.

entries.rule: Laser drag over an unselected V37 board object must not mutate the object.
entries.reason: The recovered V37 interaction rule explicitly reserves unselected-object drag for laser-only behavior.

entries.rule: Do not promote the Psicoanálisis PageKit consumer to shared PageKit/Class Player/whiteboard owner.
entries.reason: It is a distinct catalog consumer/integration artifact and is absent from the registered PageKit lineage nodes.

entries.rule: Do not mutate Lineage/CAPABILITY_REGISTRY from R07 recovery merely because a candidate capability is visible in code.
entries.reason: Those authority files remain external to this recovery worker and require their existing owner/promotion rules.

entries.rule: Do not reconstruct missing intermediate PageKit/Class Player versions from inaccessible chat memory.
entries.reason: Only exact durable artifacts may establish recovered implementation claims in this lane.
